inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all three sites); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to all three sites (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

inclusions.text: Pickup from Alexandria and return the same evening
inclusions.source: This is a private tour, operated for your party alone — your vehicle, your Egyptologist guide, your pace — with pickup from Alexandria and a full-day return the same evening.

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base package fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.
